reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Excellent experience! We left our two kittens in Marcel's care during our vacation and we couldn't be happier. 🥰

He was very attentive, caring, and responsible. When we returned home, our boys were so calm and happy that we even joked that they were waiting for Marcel more than for us! 🤣🐾

It's such a relief to travel knowing that our furry friends are in good hands.

Thank you so much, Marcel, for all the care and dedication! We recommend him without hesitation! ❤️🐱

They were super attentive and took great care of our kitten Sabrino. They sent videos and photos and explained everything clearly and in detail. They provide service on the south bank of the river. And they respect the space even when the cat is more timid. We will definitely hire them again to look after our cat. They were great. Thank you so much. 🥰

There aren't enough stars to rate Cat Nanny's service! Words also can't express my gratitude for what they did while we were on vacation. Everything was done beautifully, with love for the animal as their top priority. I recommend this service to everyone!!

They’re the best! Super professional, very responsive, and clearly true cat lovers.

A big thank you to Maiara for being so kind and caring. I trust her completely with my cat, and I know she’s always in good hands with her. My cat absolutely loves her, which says it all! :)

Attentive and very friendly team! I was assisted by Anny and she took great care of my babies. They send reports, photos and videos of each visit and respond quickly to WhatsApp! I felt very safe with their work and from now on they will be my petsitters forever 🩷

Cat Nanny did an excellent job, very professional, paying attention to every detail. Maiara took care of our Leya, who was very well looked after in our absence. All the care was documented and sent via WhatsApp so we were aware of everything. I recommend this service and will call Cat Nanny again when I'm away.

We had a wonderful experience with Cat Nanny Lisboa. Mairara checked in with our kitties twice a day and we always received a full report of each visit, along with plenty of videos and pictures.  I will definitely use this service again and I would highly recommend this service. Thanks Mairara and Marcel for your dedication, attention and genuine care of my kitties.

My 3 cats received visits from Anny for almost a fortnight, and she was always super attentive. We received lovely photos of our kittens socializing, eating, and playing.

Excellent service, I highly recommend it!
They took great care of my cat, gave him medication and fluids! Super satisfied!
We hired a catsitting service and received daily updates of our panther with photos and videos ☺️

Marcel took excellent care of our cat for more than two weeks. From our very first interaction, he was kind, transparent, and highly professional. He kept us updated every day with messages and videos, and treated our cat as if he were his own. Seeing our cat trust him so quickly gave us complete peace of mind. We are incredibly grateful to Marcel and wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking for a caring and reliable cat sitter.

Marcel took care of my two cats for a week and I recommend him 100%.
He was professional from the first contact. Every day he sent photos of the cats, the food, and the clean litter box.
At the end, he left the litter box area spotless, with no litter on the floor, and took the soiled litter to the trash.
He always kept to the schedule and what we agreed upon, which gave me a lot of peace of mind.
Five-star care for my cats, very helpful and assisted me with all the logistics. Thank you so much for the excellent service! I will call again 🙏🏻 …

We used Cat Nanny for a week to look after our two cats, and we had a great experience. They were very organized and professional in arranging the service, and always provided us with detailed summaries of the visits complete with pictures and videos. We felt that our kitties were in very good hands the whole time. Highly recommended!

Marcel is very careful and attentive with my kittens, and you can see the affection he has for them. Whenever I need to travel, I go with peace of mind, knowing they will be very well taken care of. Thank you for taking such good care of my little ones ❤️

Highly recommend! I’ve used this service twice and they exceed my expectations every time. Marcel and Maiara are fast to get back to me, and are really thorough with the care they provide. I know I never have to worry about my cat when I’m away and am so appreciative for them!
Fantastic service! With tons of photos! You can trust this company 😻 …
Marcel was great with our cats and it made us feel so much better to go away for a few days. Would definitely recommend!

We worked with Cat Nanny to watch our 2 cats while we were traveling. Marcel showed kindness and warmth to our cats on every visit. We could see he truly cared for our pets. He followed the feeding instructions exactly, was on time as scheduled and sent us videos of our babies. He did an amazing job of keeping the litter box clean and took time to play and take them outside. It’s a relief to find a service that is professional, dependable and that can be completely trusted with our cats.
The best nanny for my cats , they love him

first time hiring cat sitting services and we were impressed with how amazing it went! very professional and easy communication while we were away, our cat Blackie was very happy to have company 🐈‍⬛❤️ …
Thank you Marcos, it was a pleasure taking care of Nico! Until next time 😊🐈 …

Marcel’s teammate, Maiara, looked after my 16-year-old cat, and I’m extremely happy with the experience. My cat is calm and happy after my return, with no signs of stress at all. Maiara even managed to get him to drink water, which is not an easy task with him.

I requested overnight visits because my cat is very social, and I received photos and videos from every visit, which was really reassuring.

Everything was perfectly on time, and I was kept informed about each visit and how it went. Marcel was incredibly attentive and responsive, taking care of every question and request I had.

Overall, they were fantastic. This was honestly the smoothest and most comfortable cat-sitting experience I’ve ever had.

We hired Cat Nanny for 10 days and were rather impressed by the professionalism and warmth of the service. We will definitely think of them when we need care for our 3 cats again. If our cats could leave a review, they would rave, because not only did they get daily play time, they also got the most generous treat provider.
I was away for 3 days and during this time my cats were very well cared for by Marcel and his team. Trust and respect for animals, I recommend them!

The entire Cat Nanny team is probably my best pet sitting experience to date! Marcel and his team have sat my two senior cats twice and each time I have felt confident in their ability to take care of my boys while I’m away. They LOVE cats and it shows! They not only follow all of my instructions (there are a lot haha), but even go the extra mile to provide companionship, care, and thoughtful recommendations for my boys. My last trip occurred during the intense storm and Marcel made sure that the boys were looked after but also that my home was in tip top shape (as it can leak in extreme weather). I would highly recommend this company to absolutely anyone who needs kinda and thoughtful cat care. They’re truly the best out there!

I left my cat at Cat Nanny and the treatment was simply excellent. Marcel is super attentive, caring, and super professional. Every day he sent photos and videos of my cat, which made me extremely calm and happy during the trip.
Without a doubt, I will use this service again, I recommend it 100%.

Amazing experience. We had an emergency while we were away and all It took to solve was to call Cat Nanny Lisboa. They understood all the situation and helped us to solve the situation in Just the perfect way. I would had put even more than the maximum!!

Excellent service. It was the first time I needed a cat sitter for my feline children, and now I'm confident I can count on this service when needed. It greatly reduced the stress of traveling and leaving someone to care for them. Marcel clearly understands cats very well and everything that comes with them (an automatic litter box, for example, which I had recently bought and hadn't yet had time to fully understand). Maiara was a great cat sitter, caring, responsible, and very kind. We received feedback through photos and videos after each visit. Communication was easy. I recommend them 😻

Amazing! We used the service during one of the worst times of the year, and even on Christmas Day my kittens had visitors! Everything was clean, tidy, the kittens were happy... truly a relief for the owners. I recommend it 100%.

Working with Cat Nanny was an absolute dream! Maiara was able to make our shy cat feel very comfortable and the level of professionalism and communication was excellent. Will absolutely use this service again and cannot recommend highly enough! Thank you Marcel and Maiara!!

Highly recommend!
Committed, punctual, and attentive to Nala. 🥹🙏🫶 🐈‍⬛ …

I recommend Cat Nanny Lisboa to anyone looking for a serious company with people who work out of love for their profession.
Marcel, who took care of our cat Bento during our absence, is an excellent person we had the opportunity to meet, very committed and always friendly.
It was our first experience with cat sitting services and we hope to use them again in the future. Thank you very much!

Marcel is fantastic. Exceptional care and affection for our kittens.

We were so happy to receive daily photos and videos of our kittens being well cared for while we traveled.

We highly recommend him!

Marcel is a very attentive and caring person! Our kittens, Simão and Safira, quickly got used to him! We received photos and videos every day, and we noticed how well cared for and comfortable they were with him. We highly recommend him and will hire him whenever we travel ♥️

Serena and Mana loved the care! 💕
Marcel was super attentive with the meal instructions and even sent several photos of my daughters while we were traveling, so we were able to ease the longing a little.

We highly recommend the service! 🌟
Very helpful, kind, and respectful of the kittens! Reliable service, highly recommend.
Marcel took excellent care of my cat, Charlie, for two weeks. He regularly sent me photos and videos, which was very reassuring. I was extremely satisfied with his services and highly recommend him!

It was the first time I left my two kittens in someone's care, and Marcel exceeded my expectations! One of them is more shy, and I was a little worried, but I quickly realized they were in great hands. Marcel was extremely attentive and careful.

During the visits, he sent many photos and videos, which reassured me and made me happy to see that they were well and comfortable with his presence. His genuine affection and care were evident.

I will definitely trust him again to take care of my kittens.

Marcel is an incredible human being who took impeccable care of our 3 cats. Always helpful and present, with frequent feedback. I can't recommend him more highly, and if you're looking for someone, don't hesitate to hire his services.
Marcel and Fernanda were impeccable, attentive, competent, and diligent in sending updates and photos. It was the first time I hired a service of this kind, and I highly recommend them!

Great service from Marcel - he sent lots of photos and videos to show that our cats were doing fine and he treated them very well. I'd definitely recommend him to anyone in Lisbon needing a cat sitter.

I took a long trip and, upon returning, found my kittens safe and happy. I have a Bengal cat, and anyone familiar with this breed knows how particular they are, almost with the personality of dogs, very dependent. My cat usually meows a lot when I arrive, as a way of complaining about my absence, but this time I noticed she was calmer. This shows me that she was well cared for by Marcel. I feel confident leaving her in his care again and, therefore, I recommend him.
Super professional and caring with our girls! Definitely a repeat business. Thank you for the photos and videos of the visits, which reassured us. 5-star service.

This was the first time I used a pet sitting service for Caju and Miúxa during my vacation, and I have no hesitation in saying that I will repeat the choice. Marcel was incredibly professional and caring. In Caju's case, who is only 4 months old and very dependent on me, the concern was doubled (and the amount of destruction was proportional 😅). Marcel was super attentive to all these special needs and, more than just food and pampering, provided them with security, comfort, and peace of mind during my absence. This peace of mind extended to me as a result of the frequent sharing of information, videos, and photographs, which, as a bonus, were all incredible. I highly recommend Cat Nanny Lisboa's services to all tourists looking for guarantees of restful vacations/business trips.
They took care of my two kittens while I was on vacation. Super professional. I loved it and recommend them.

Marcel from Cat Nanny Lisboa was super helpful from the start.
He was very attentive and caring with our two kittens, Tatu & Tula.

Thank you for the excellent service 😊

I'm so lucky to have them. I was looking for someone to take care of my two feline companions and I found Marcel, and I couldn't be happier. The first time, Fernanda came, and she was so sweet with my cats. When Marcel comes, even my most "shy" cat melts when he's with him. It's incredible the energy he gives them; they're so happy with him. This way, I can travel with peace of mind, and my cats are calm with them. They're super professional and send photos and videos of their visit. It couldn't be better. Thank you so much!
Excellent service

I highly recommend the CatNanny service. Marcel took care of my cat during the holidays and was very competent and attentive. He treated Mirtila very well, sending daily videos and photos of the visits, and it's clear he really likes cats and has a great way with them. It was a great help and I was able to have a relaxing holiday. It's great to be able to count on them and I will call them whenever I travel.

We're still on vacation and it was so heartwarming to see the kittens being treated by Marcel. Especially since one of them is more fragile and needs medication. Thank you :) It's already arranged for August ❤️

Fernanda from Cat Nanny did simply a wonderful job. She took care of my 3 elderly cats with so much love and attention. My cats, besides being elderly, have their quirks and special needs, and she was impeccable. I received frequent updates on the visits, photos, and videos, which made me feel super reassured.

I had never used this cat sitter service before, but I will definitely use her services again.

The service from Cat Nanny was impeccable; they cared for our kittens with the utmost attention and affection. A trustworthy service! I will definitely hire them again when needed and highly recommend them to anyone who requires such services.

Our experience was excellent, we felt very comfortable leaving our cat Mel with Marcel, who took care of her and sent photos and videos every day! The organization is impeccable, and we will definitely use your services again whenever we need them! Thank you 😊 …
We were looking for a solution for cat sitting for ages, as our little one is quite “particular”. Marcel was amazing, he always kept us up to date, and we'll definitely be in touch again!

Marcel did an amazing job taking care of our two cats (and our plants!) while we were away on holiday.  We came home to two relaxed and happy cats and the house was exactly as we left it.  Marcel also took the time to send really lovely photos and videos everyday and was always keeping us posted on how they were each day.  He even watered our plants!  I can't recommend him enough, and we will absolutely ask him to watch them again in the future!

The attention and care our cat received was incredible. Communication was never a problem, as Marcel is super diligent in responding to messages and sending photos and videos during his visits. I 100% recommend CatNanny/Marcel if you're looking for respectful, punctual, and organized pet care.

It was difficult for us when our usual pet sitters left, but Marcel managed to win our hearts with his professionalism, care, empathy, and kindness towards both animals and humans.
I recommend him 100%.
You can choose him without hesitation :)

This was the first time I used Cat Nancy's services, and I couldn't be happier. Everything went beautifully, I received photos of my cats every day, and when I arrived they were super calm. 5-star service, which I will definitely use again.

Marcel from Cat Nanny Lisboa took care of our three kittens, Mimi, Faísca, and Fumaça, for 10 days with so much love and attention!

Our biggest concern was Mimi, who is undergoing cancer treatment and needs to take medication every day. We only feel at ease knowing he's eaten properly. Therefore, we arranged visits twice a day, and Marcel was incredible! Super responsible, caring, and always attentive to detail. He sent us photos, videos (including one of Mimi taking his medication to see if he wasn't trying to trick Marcel 😅) and messages that reassured us so much.

The care was so good that Mimi even gained weight during that time, meaning he was well and comfortable. And yes, we've already booked his care for our babies for our next vacation 🥰

Thank you so much for your kindness and see you soon 😻😻😻

I highly recommend Marcel's work. He was super attentive and careful with our 4 "puppies". It was the first time we traveled and left them like that for a few days, and the experience with Cat Nancy couldn't have been better.

Amazing! I couldn't recommend Cat Nanny Lisboa any higher. We've hired Marcel several times now, and he always goes above and beyond.

He sends me videos of my cats taking their medicine and getting their food every AM and PM, and other videos of him interacting with them. He sends pictures of the clean litterbox, and the refilled water station. He sends cute pictures of them too, and I can feel that he cares about them.

It was very scary for me to leave my cats alone with a stranger, but now he's friends with all three of them (which isn't always the case with my maniac cats). I also really appreciated his complete acceptance of cameras inside the house, so I can check in - it gave me confidence that he himself was so confident in his services.

Do yourself a favor and go with this company, if you're looking for  reliable, personable and kind service! Thank you, Marcel!

It was the first time for us to use a cat nanny and I was amazed how professional they did their job. Everyday they sat down to also entertain the cats, feed them accurately and sent us pictures and videos of our happy cats and the job being done. If anyone ever needs someone to take care of their cats, please hire Cat Nanny!

It was the first time we left our two kittens "alone" during a trip, and Marcel understood our concern and put us completely at ease! From the first visit, he understood the personality of each cat and was super attentive. During all the visits, he sent us photos and videos so that we could be completely relaxed. Even our most timid cat didn't take long to trust Marcel and quickly accepted the affection and the visit. When we returned, we found everything in order, the cats' corner super clean, and everyone happy! We couldn't have left them in better hands, I highly recommend him! Thank you so much Marcel and the Cat Nanny team!

We traveled for 30 days and Marcel took care of our cats Gohan and Molly. Gohan is sick and needs medication twice a day, and Marcel was very patient administering the medication and ensuring she didn't throw it up. Molly is more skittish and usually doesn't accept affection from strangers, but after a few days she was already rolling onto her back when he arrived. We felt very reassured during the trip because he sent us photos and videos of them on every visit so we could see how well they were doing. We are very grateful for the excellent service provided.

Best pet sitter I have used! They provided daily photos and videos, took good care of my babies. One day there was a power outage in Lisbon and public transport halted , Fernanda walked two metro stations to provide service ! I will use them again for sure !

Marcel's work was impeccable. For 3 weeks he took care of our daughter in the best way possible, while the parents enjoyed their trip. I recommend him wholeheartedly to anyone who needs his services 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻 …

Highly recommended service!
Marcel has a lot of experience with cats and you can tell he loves animals.
Given all the constraints I had, Marcel and his sister did everything to make my life easier and take care of my kitten.

Marcel has a lot of experience handling cats.
My Nina was very well taken care of; I constantly received updates and photos. She was very well treated!
The service provided was exemplary!
Thank you!

Thank you for the care, attention, and professionalism you showed our puppies!

I definitely recommend them.
See you soon!
Thank you!
Good service, helpful and attentive to detail. I recommend it.

My kitten spent 10 days in the care of Cat Nanny Lisboa and was VERY well treated and pampered. I felt completely at ease leaving him with them. I will definitely need their services again. Thank you, Cat Nanny!

Marcel took such great care of my cat Crunch and sent me videos and pictures to update me while I was away.  Crunch clearly had a great time with lots of attention and care.  It was my first time using a cat sitter in Lisbon and I am so glad we were recommended Cat Nanny Lisboa.  Thank you Marcel - Crunch will miss you until next time :)
Thank you, Catarina! Maria Gadú is super cute and we love taking care of her. Until next time! 😊🐈 …

When I moved to Lisbon, the first thing I looked for was a cat sitting service in case I needed to travel with my family. Then I found CatNanny on Instagram and have been following their profile for 3 years. The time for the trip arrived and I was apprehensive about my 4 little ones. I contacted Cat Nanny, was quickly assisted, and the team took care of my 4 cats for 5 days. I felt so calm, always receiving updates, photos, and videos. I saw that they were all comfortable with him, each in their own way. Marcel followed all my instructions. They also provided a camera service so I could see them at any time during the trip, always putting me at ease. If you love your pet, I highly recommend Cat Nanny Lisbon's service. Impeccable!

I started using Marcel's (Cat Nanny) service during a vacation when I needed someone to take care of my cat Pisky. Fantastic service. Great communication, constant feedback on Pisky, with videos and photos. I recommend it 100%.

It was the first time we looked for a catsitting service, so we were a little anxious, since our cat is a bit wary and sometimes unfriendly.
Marcel immediately put us at ease with the fact that we had cameras in the house to keep an eye on the cats. And his treatment was spectacular! He brought a laser to play with them and was always very patient with Jinx. By the second day she was already more used to it :) In addition, he kept sending photos and videos, which reassured us a lot! Without a doubt, we will count on you again on our next vacation!
Marcel was responsive and reliable. The cat was happy.
Marcel is professional and cares for the pets with dedication. He kept us informed and always sent us pictures and videos during the 3 weeks we were out of Portugal.

Stellar cat sitting service. Marcel took very good care of my cat Opi who is a bit more shy but very playful. He cleaned the litter perfectly, as well as the cat bowl and played with her. He also installed my camera on the last day so I could see her before I return home. Five stars

We chose Cat Nanny Lisboa to take care of our two kittens while we were on vacation and I couldn't be happier! Marcel, who looked after them, is super attentive and very careful with everything! Every day he sent us photos and videos of them eating, playing and receiving affection, which helped us to feel more at ease and to ease the longing a little! Marcel also installed a camera so we could see them 24/7! Marie and Puré were great when we arrived and adapted super well to the whole routine, without missing us so much! We are very grateful, once again!

Will definitely use Cat Nanny Lisboa again to take care of my kitties. Daily updates with pictures and videos. You can see that Marcel gives them the time to get confortable with him and really interact with them.

Wow! Thank you, Marcel, for taking such good care of Tera and Zen while we travel, and for keeping us in the loop by sending photos & videos of them. Marcel is extremely caring, compassionate, reliable, and organised, and I would fully recommend anyone looking for a trusted cat sitter to get in touch with him.

This was the first time I used this type of service. I needed it at the last minute for Christmas 2024 and they were super friendly and, even with their busy schedule, managed to fit me in.

Their concern and care for the kittens is evident and made me feel very reassured from the first time we met in person. I will definitely hire their services again. I highly recommend them because I know how important it is to find trustworthy people to take care of those we love ❤️

Great service. Marcel was very friendly and communication was easy. You can sense that Marcel has a lot of experience with cats and knows how to adapt to their behaviour. We were sent daily pictures and videos. Overall great service, I will use it again.

I was away for 20 days and entrusted my two kittens to Marcel's care. I was worry-free the whole time because I knew they were being well taken care of. I followed the service daily through photos and videos taken during visits, which clearly showed the attention and affection dedicated to the kittens. Besides cleaning the litter boxes and preparing food and water, Marcel dedicated a good part of his time to playing, greatly entertaining my more sociable cat, who quickly became fond of him. The other kitten is super anxious and afraid of everything, but Marcel respected her space and tried to approach her at her pace, with all possible care. Oh, and he even did me the favor of picking up a package for me 😺🙏🏻 Complete service and highly recommended!
Excellent service. Marcel is very reliable and sent us so many photo and video updates, will definitely use this service everytime we go away!

I was able to travel peacefully and with complete peace of mind knowing that my cats were being well cared for by Marcel. Marcel was always punctual and attentive. He will certainly be my first choice for future trips.

Marcel was a pleasure to work with! He is very kind, flexible, and responsive. He understands cats very well and I always felt that my cats were safe and cared for. I will definitely use Cat Nanny Lisboa for my next trip! Thanks Marcel!!

Marcel looked after our Maggie incredibly well and communicated everything the entire time, we really felt like we could take our mind off of her and enjoy our vacations as she was being so well taken care of! Thanks Cat Nanny Lisboa!

We used Marcel and Fernanda’s house-sitting service while we were traveling, and everything went smoothly from start to finish. The handover was seamless, and we really appreciated receiving daily updates with photos, which reassured us that our cat was doing well. It was a great experience, and we highly recommend their service!

I want to express my immense gratitude to Marcel for the excellent care he provided for my cat. His attention, affection, and professionalism made all the difference. They were very organized and always shared all the details live. I felt reassured knowing she was in good hands! I highly recommend them.
We've used several catsitting services before, but this one is extraordinary. Responsible, organized, and honest, I highly recommend their services!

My experience with Marcel was fantastic. He is extremely attentive and organized, and he was very affectionate with my cat Sardi, playing with her and sending me videos and photos throughout the visit. Sardi seemed very happy, and I felt at ease! I highly recommend him!!
Very good service

Marcel was extremely caring towards my cat, sending photos of everything, and in addition to feeding him, cleaning the litter box, and administering medication, he even played with him. He was always kind, available, and trustworthy.

Excellent work, organization, and communication.
I will hire them again and recommend them.
We really enjoyed it! Marcel was very careful with Antony, always attentive and helpful to our needs. We highly recommend the service.

We had a great experience with Marcel, our cats enjoyed his company and he was very keen to always communicate and send us pics/vids about how our cats are doing. He is very professional and trustworthy. Overall, we felt reassured that our cats are in good hands when we’re not there 😻 …
Thanks Kate, it was a pleasure take care of Gaia!
Marcel has been a fantastic sitter for my cats and helped give me a lot of peace of mind while I travel without them. Already booked Cat Nanny for my next trip ❤️

We feel so lucky to have found Marcel to take care of our 2 cats. He is by far the best cat-sitter we've had! He was super responsive, kept us updated with lots of videos and photos, and was great at communicating. Plus, his whole energy is just positive, so you know your pets will be well-cared for when you are away. At the end of our time away, we got home to happy cats, a tidy house, and even a sweet note and some chocolates Marcel left for us! We definitely recommend him to anyone looking for an amazing cat sitter in Lisboa!

We hired Cat Nanny's service for the first time, and Marcel always sent photos and videos of our kitten.

I definitely recommend the service 😻

Our cats liked Marcel from the first moment, we were so relieved to receive videos of them so calm and purring! ❤️
We loved it.
Everything was fine 😻 …

We felt very comfortable with leaving our cat to Cat Nanny Lisboa. Marcel updated us with lots of pictures (very good ones actually!), and our cat seemed very happy with him. She had time to play, to cuddle, she got brushed…It helped a lot …

I am extremely satisfied with Marcel work by taking care of my cat Athena. He sent me everyday an update with lots of pictures of my cat and also of food, water and clean sand. He's very responsive and attentive, I will definitely require the Cat Nanny services again!

Marcel took great care of our kitten and sent very detailed videos of everything he did (feeding, cleaning, etc. ). Our Teddy was a very happy cat even without us around! Wonderful cat sitting service!
